7 mistakes new creators make on social media 👇🏼

1️⃣ Being way too vague

If you’re trying to talk to everyone, your content usually ends up connecting with no one. 

Get specific about the actual day-to-day thoughts, struggles, and moments your audience is experiencing so they can see themselves in your content.

2️⃣ Trying to put five ideas into one reel

Break it up. Make each one easier to consume and get more out of the ideas you already have.

3️⃣ Making the editing way too busy

Too many effects, too much text, and too much happening on screen can make people confused.

Your content needs to be clear and immediately easy to understand.

4️⃣ Getting way too emotionally attached to the results

Not every reel is going to perform the way you want it to.

Instead of letting one post ruin your day, look at it as data.

Ask yourself.. What worked? What didn’t? What could I improve next time?

That way you can learn from your content without taking every result personally.

5️⃣ Having no energy in the video

Your energy absolutely matters.

If you look miserable or like you don’t even want to be creating the content, people are going to feel that.

You don’t have to be over the top, but loosen up and have some fun!

6️⃣ Not giving people a reason to stop

You need some kind of hook.. I know I know we talk about them all the time. But they are key! 

That could be what you say, text on the screen, a visual, movement, or something happening in the first few seconds.

But also keeping attention throughout the reel too. So add some re-hooks throughout!

7️⃣ Taking way too long to get to the point

Too many pauses and too much explaining before you actually say the thing.

You want to cut any filler and get to the point quicker.

People aren’t going to wait around forever for you to make your point.

Bio Breakdown 👇🏼

✨ Name Field - Add your name + keywords that align with what you do but also what your audience is searching for. This is a great way for your audience to find you when searching for what you do.

✨ 3rd Line of Bio - Call to Action. What do you want your audience to do? Do you want them to follow you, grab your free guide, DM you, book with you? Add that here. 

✨ Link - Have one link in your IG. It can lead to multiple options, but remember the fewer decisions you give people, the higher your conversions.

✨ Profile Picture - Remember the image is small so zoom in on your face so you can see it nice and clearly. And don’t have any distractions in the background.

1️⃣ Hashtags 5/10 - We are now limited to only 5 hashtags per post but being strategic about them can help Instagram categorize your content. And if someone searches for that hashtag then your reel will pop up. With that being said, my students content has performed well with hashtags and without. It comes down to your content at the end of the day.

2️⃣ Optimized Bio 10/10 - This is the first thing people see when they come to your profile and they will know within 2 seconds if they’re going to follow you or not. Make sure it’s optimized for your target audience. 

3️⃣ Trending Audio 5/10 - It can help boost your content if you correlate it with your reel and can make it more engaging. But talking head reels and voiceovers are just as (if not more) powerful. 

4️⃣ Optimized Profile 8/10 - This is referring to your highlights and pinned reels. Another first that your audience sees when they come to your page. Make sure they explain what you’re about, what you offer, and share your results and testimonials.

5️⃣ Watch Time 10/10 - This is just as important as engagement. If your audience doesn’t watch your reel all the way through then Instagram will stop pushing it. So we want to make sure we keep the reel engaging throughout as best as we can.

6️⃣ Fancy Equipment 2/10 - I grew my account filming from a super old iPhone and a $15 iPhone stand from Amazon. And to this day I still only use my iPhone. Not something to prioritize when you’re starting out. 

7️⃣ Hooks 10/10 - We talk about them all the time but they are key. So many ways to hook your audience too. Text, visual, auditory, curiosity, pattern interrupts, and more. You have 2 seconds to grab your audiences attention but you also have to keep it. Hooks are just as important throughout the reel as they are in the beginning.

8️⃣ Trends 6/10 - These are a great way to connect with your audience and show some personality. This is like trending audio where you want to jump on them early. The earlier you are on a trend,  the better. This isn’t something you want to do all the time but it does make your content more engaging.
